theorem: For every odd prime power q, the binary kernel of the line-intersection adjacency matrix of W(3,q) has minimum distance q+1. Minimum words are pairwise-skew (q+1)-sets with the exact 0/2 transversal parity law; an anisotropic-plane conic in the dual Q(4,q) supplies equality. The canonical projective J-involution fixes q+1 lines for q=3 mod 4 and q+3 lines for q=1 mod 4.
prior_art_boundary: Related odd-q line/neighborhood codes of Sp(4,q) and O(5,q) were studied by Bagchi-Brouwer-Wilbrink (1991), and related symplectic adjacency codes by Key-Moori-Rodrigues (2005). This certificate records the explicit line-intersection-kernel proof and involution branch used here without asserting publication novelty.
